records.title: TransHarness: From Benchmark Overfitting to Transferable Harness Evolution
records.claim: Harness intervention policies evolved from success-failure contrasts transfer across benchmarks instead of overfitting the evolution set.

method_and_setup.method: Evolves harness intervention policies from same-task success-failure contrasts with cross-task replay and independent semantic selection.
method_and_setup.setup: 300 source trajectories from outside the test distribution; cross-benchmark evaluation over multiple models and harnesses.

results.measures: state-of-the-art score
state-of-the-art score

records.change_for_agents: Evolve harness checks from paired success/failure runs and validate them on a held-out task distribution before keeping them.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Harness policies learned from few trajectories that survive a distribution shift are directly usable for the Claude Code / MCP harness.

records.title: MetaDecomp: Adaptive Task Decomposition via Meta-Learned Procedural Memory
records.claim: Meta-learned procedural memory with abstract progress states lets small-model language agents decompose long tasks better and cheaper than ReAct.

method_and_setup.method: In-context meta-learning framework; outer loop builds procedural memory as DAGs between abstract states, inner loop refines decomposition from feedback.
method_and_setup.setup: ALFWorld and ScienceWorld over three seeds.

results.value: 86.3% success rate on ALFWorld with Qwen3-4B
results.measures: success rate

records.change_for_agents: Store reusable procedures as state-to-state graphs and let the agent revise the plan from environment feedback.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A 4B local model reaching 86.3% on ALFWorld with procedural memory fits a small on-device planner design.

records.title: What Does Skill Lift Actually Measure? A Source-Code-Level Audit and Noise-Aware Reanalysis of SkillsBench
records.claim: SkillsBench's skill-lift numbers are partly artifacts of grader dependence, placeholder skills and run noise, so per-task harm from skills is not established.

method_and_setup.method: Source-code audit of SkillsBench plus noise-aware reanalysis of public trials with multiple-testing correction.
method_and_setup.setup: 7,554 public trials forming 1,421 paired (configuration, task) cells.

results.measures: overall average lift for the full set
average lift on the three tasks with grader or definition issues

records.change_for_agents: Do not gate or drop skills on per-task lift from at most three runs per cell; run more repeats first.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Before pruning skills in your own skill library based on small-run deltas, check the noise floor.

records.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
records.claim: Letting models decide when and what to compact through a context API beats harness-triggered compaction, especially at tight budgets.

method_and_setup.method: Models given a context API inside NVIDIA's open source agent harness, compared against harness-managed compaction.
method_and_setup.setup: Document research and ML engineering tasks, context budgets from 8K to 512K tokens.

results.value: GPT 6.1 nearly triples its score at a 32K budget
results.measures: score on OfficeQA Pro v2

records.change_for_agents: Expose a compact/drop-context tool to the model rather than auto-summarizing when the window fills.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Direct input to how Claude Code-style harnesses and Mitamaton should handle context pressure.

records.title: EgoUseBench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents under Evolving First-Person Contexts
records.claim: Computer-use agents do markedly worse when tasks originate from first-person wearable context than from explicit computer instructions.

method_and_setup.method: Benchmark built from first-person recordings with three interaction settings.
method_and_setup.setup: Over 74 hours of real-world first-person recordings, 693 tasks.

results.measures: average success rate in Online Ego Use versus Computer-Use

records.change_for_agents: Test computer-use agents on tasks inferred from ambient context, not only explicit instructions.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Relevant to proactive iOS/wearable-triggered agent tasks.

records.title: Procedure Inference as Memory: Learning Recruiter Decision Procedures from OKF-Structured Episodes in Multi-Session Hiring Assistants
records.claim: An indexed episodic memory with lineage retrieval beats full-history context and conversation search for inferring evolving preferences, with fewer tokens.

method_and_setup.method: OKF-indexed episodic memory organizing interactions and retrieving related events through their lineage.
method_and_setup.setup: Multi-session hiring-assistant evaluation versus no memory, full history and conversation search.

results.measures: low-priority preference F1 at medium and high preference overlap

records.change_for_agents: Index episodes with lineage links and navigate the index instead of replaying full history.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A concrete alternative to full-history context for a day-admin agent's long-term preferences.

records.title: HoMe: Toward Practical Harness Optimization of Memory Systems for AI Assistants
records.claim: Optimizing the harness of a long-running assistant's memory system is mostly manual, and unrestricted editing alone does not ensure structural improvements.

method_and_setup.method: HoMe: harness optimization for memory systems covering construction, maintenance, retrieval and answer generation.

records.change_for_agents: Treat memory construction, maintenance and retrieval code as an optimizable harness with structural constraints.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Targets exactly the memory write/read policy tuning that persistent assistants need.

records.title: TASK Memory: Beyond Text-Only Memory with Activation Steering and Knowledge Editing against Memory Hallucination
records.claim: Agents hallucinate against their own retrieved memory through memory-ignoring, memory-misapplying and version confusion, which weight-side steering and editing can address.

method_and_setup.method: Five open models studied; TASK Memory adds activation steering and knowledge editing to text memory.
method_and_setup.setup: Five open models.

results.measures: memory-ignoring where the model returns to a stale fact in its weights
assert the superseded value when both versions remain stored

records.change_for_agents: When a fact is revised, delete or mark the superseded version instead of storing both.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Memory stores with revised facts need supersession handling; open local models show the failure.

records.title: Semantic Density Does Not Predict Agent-Memory Collapse
records.claim: Memory-store statistics like semantic density do not warn before agent-memory accuracy collapses.

method_and_setup.method: Registered geometry, retrieval and graph statistics used to train classifiers applied unchanged to held-out runs.
method_and_setup.setup: 805 snapshots from 13 memory methods across six environments; PropWorld runs of up to 5,000 crafting tasks.

results.measures: of checkpoints from size-limited stores with stable accuracy falsely flagged
of checkpoints detected after task success fell to zero

records.change_for_agents: Monitor held-out task accuracy of a memory store, not embedding statistics, to detect degradation.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Cheap store-statistic health checks for agent memory are not reliable.

records.title: PRECEPT: Security Self-Improvement of Coding Agents via Evolving Principles
records.claim: Coding agents reintroduce fixed vulnerability classes in new sessions about as often as agents that never saw them, and evolving principles reduce this.

method_and_setup.method: PRECEPT evolves security principles for coding agents.
method_and_setup.setup: 14 task sequences with Codex, Claude Code and Qwen Code.

results.measures: reintroduced the same vulnerability class in a new session
secure working code for PRECEPT's weakest agent on unseen task families

records.change_for_agents: Carry distilled security principles across sessions instead of relying on per-session fixes.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Claude Code sessions forget security fixes; persistent principles are a harness-level fix.

records.title: The Detour Is the Danger: Preserving Security During LLM Agent Recovery
records.claim: Agent replanning after tool failure can silently drop the security protections of the original workflow.

method_and_setup.method: ARGUS enforcement preventing protection-loss during recovery of tool and Skill workflows.
method_and_setup.setup: 864-run evaluation.

records.change_for_agents: Check that a recovery plan keeps every guard of the original workflow before executing it.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Replanning after tool failures is a guard-bypass path for Mitamaton.

records.title: When Are Parallel Subagents Effective for Coding? An Empirical Study on Repository Construction
records.claim: Parallel subagents add only a small hidden-test gain on repository construction at much higher cost.

method_and_setup.method: Single agent versus main agent delegating to parallel subagents.
method_and_setup.setup: Repository-construction tasks from NL2Repo and ProgramBench.

results.measures: hidden-test pass rate gain from parallel subagents
cost of a single agent

records.change_for_agents: Prefer a self-check prompt over spawning parallel subagents unless measured gain justifies cost.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Cost-gates subagent delegation in Claude Code workflows.

records.title: Connecting AI Agents to Live Discrete Element Simulations via the Model Context Protocol
records.claim: An MCP server lets a general-purpose agent operate a discrete element engine while the simulation runs.

method_and_setup.method: MCP server and bridge for commercial and open-source engines; agent reads, changes or stops a running model.
method_and_setup.setup: Released as itasca-mcp and yade-mcp.

records.change_for_agents: Make long-running tools MCP-driven so the agent can inspect and modify state mid-run.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A pattern for long-running tool jobs over MCP.

records.title: MINE: A Training-Free Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection via Mutual Information and Embedding Variance
records.claim: A training-free defense against indirect prompt injection works by maximizing relevance using mutual information and embedding variance rather than detecting attacks.

method_and_setup.method: MINE, training-free defense; new LC-Inj-SQuAD long-context benchmark.
method_and_setup.setup: Average of 4,032 words per context.

results.measures: average context length in LC-Inj-SQuAD

records.change_for_agents: Rank context by relevance to the query to dilute injected instructions.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A cheap retrieval-side defense to compare against guard prompts.

records.title: Latent-in-the-Middle: On the Security of Cross-Model Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
records.claim: Cross-model KV-cache handoffs undermine safety alignment and prompt-injection defenses, and a target-side cache guard mitigates this.

method_and_setup.method: Chasm framework with three attack surfaces; lightweight target-side cache guard.
method_and_setup.setup: Cross-model KV cache transfer with a learned mapper.

results.measures: benchmark prompt injections followed natively
followed when transferred through a mapper

records.change_for_agents: Do not hand off KV caches across models without a guard on the receiving side.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Warns against latent handoff between agent models.

records.title: When Skills Fail to Compose: Compatibility and Retention in Language Models
records.claim: Independently learned soft-prompt skills do not compose in one call.

method_and_setup.method: Independently learned soft-prompt skills on frozen language models, identities and order supplied.
method_and_setup.setup: Four digit-task bases and three record-editing models.

results.measures: mean composition accuracy in one call
over two calls with explicit intermediate output

records.change_for_agents: Compose skills with an explicit intermediate output between calls.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Skill chains should pass explicit intermediates.

records.title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
records.claim: Budget-aware routing of agents across a model pool matches the strongest multi-agent system at much lower cost.

method_and_setup.method: MeterRouter dynamic routing for multi-agent systems.
method_and_setup.setup: Five benchmarks, three-tier LLM pool.

results.measures: than the strongest MAS router

records.change_for_agents: Route each agent role to a cheaper model tier under a spend budget.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Cost control across subagent roles.

records.title: EvoLink-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Interdependent Task Streams
records.claim: A benchmark for self-evolving agents across long interdependent task streams under persistence conditions.

method_and_setup.method: EvoLink-Bench with L1 knowledge and L2 task-capability levels.
method_and_setup.setup: Five agent frameworks, three backbone configurations, three persistence conditions.

results.measures: scored task slots

records.change_for_agents: Evaluate agents with persistence on and off across a task stream.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Benchmark for persistence of learned state.

records.title: vSFT: Learning to Verbally Tune Agents at Test Time
records.claim: Verbal supervised fine-tuning gives dense feedback at test time and beats GRPO and Reflexion on ALFWorld and WebShop.

method_and_setup.method: vSFT conjoining natural-language feedback with supervised fine-tuning.
method_and_setup.setup: Qwen3-4B on ALFWorld and WebShop.

results.measures: success-rate gains over GRPO and Reflexion on ALFWorld

records.change_for_agents: Tune a small agent at test time from verbal feedback instead of RL rollouts.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Test-time tuning for a small local agent.

records.title: How Much Do Coding Agents Over-Edit, and Why? An Empirical Study of Unneeded Edits in Repository-Level Agent Patches
records.claim: Agent patches change more lines than developers' but extra edits are mostly tests and docs on SWE-bench Verified.

method_and_setup.method: Analysis of unneeded edits across 18 frontier models.
method_and_setup.setup: 7,660 GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE.

results.measures: extra edits that add tests on SWE-bench Verified
extra edits that are code on DeepSWE

records.change_for_agents: Judge patch size by edit necessity, not line count.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Interpreting coding-agent diffs.

records.title: MGMem: An Efficient, Deterministic, and Provenance-Preserving Framework for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
records.claim: A deterministic provenance-preserving memory indexing avoids generative LLM calls to rewrite history.

method_and_setup.method: MGMem long-horizon agent memory framework.

records.change_for_agents: Index memory without LLM rewriting to keep builds cheap and traceable.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Deterministic memory with provenance is attractive for on-device agents.

records.title: Failure Broadens, Success Sharpens: Continual Adaptation of Tool-Use Agents Across Diverse Tasks with Dual-Polarity Memory
records.claim: Memory from local failures broadens and from successes sharpens tool-use agent adaptation.

method_and_setup.method: DualPM retrieval-free dual-polarity memory with periodic consolidation.
method_and_setup.setup: Heterogeneous streams of multi-domain tool-use tasks.

records.change_for_agents: Keep reflections from both successes and failures and consolidate periodically under a capacity cap.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Memory maintenance recipe for tool-use agents.

records.title: PRIOR: Pre-Call Reasoning in SFT and Its Influence on Tool-Use Retention under RL
records.claim: The tool-call depth of SFT data affects whether tool use is retained during RL.

method_and_setup.method: Low, Medium and High SFT datasets with matched token budgets; PRIOR pre-call reasoning.

records.change_for_agents: Include pre-call reasoning in SFT data for tool use that survives RL.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Guides fine-tuning of local tool-calling models.

records.title: What Must LLM Agents Communicate? From Information Loss to Communication Failures
records.claim: Teams of LLM agents can collectively hold all needed information yet fail through insufficient communication.

method_and_setup.method: Study of three requirements for effective communication.

records.change_for_agents: Check that messages between agents convey sufficient information.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Inter-agent message design.

records.title: Agent-as-a-Verifier: From Scores to Evidence for General Verification
records.claim: An agent that gathers evidence verifies outputs better than scalar score verifiers.

method_and_setup.method: Agent-as-a-Verifier replaces scalar reward prediction with evidence-gathering.
method_and_setup.setup: Terminal-Bench 2.1.

records.change_for_agents: Use an evidence-gathering verifier agent instead of a scalar judge.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Verifier agents for harness checks.

records.title: Partial Routing: Trace-Tuned Delegation for Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflows
records.claim: Partial routing delegates parts of a task to cheaper models and beats the lead alone.

method_and_setup.method: Trace-tuned partial routing with a lead model and delegation.
method_and_setup.setup: Held-out tasks from ViBench and Terminal-Bench 4.0.

results.measures: ViBench score with delta = 0.75, at 19% lower cost

records.change_for_agents: Delegate sub-steps to cheaper models rather than routing whole tasks.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Cost-saving delegation pattern.

records.title: Poisoning Self-Evolving Security Policies in LLM Agents
records.claim: Self-evolving security policies can be poisoned to cause over-refusal.

method_and_setup.method: Poisoning attack on learned reusable defense policies.
method_and_setup.setup: Ten Nemotron runs; transferred to gpt-oss-120b.

records.change_for_agents: Review learned security policies before they are adopted.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Self-learned guards are an attack surface.

records.title: ZeroHero: Training Small Language Agents from Scratch
records.claim: Small agents under 50M parameters can be trained from scratch on expert LLM trajectories.

method_and_setup.method: ZeroHero pretraining on successful expert responses.
method_and_setup.setup: Each SLA has fewer than 50 million parameters.

records.change_for_agents: Distill an expert LLM's successful trajectories into a tiny specialized agent.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Tiny on-device specialist agents.

records.title: JOVE ICE: Intent Guided Cloud Edge Device Collaboration for AI Glasses
records.claim: Intent-guided device/cloud routing for AI glasses cuts latency and tokens while keeping quality.

method_and_setup.method: JOVE ICE handles simple device control on device.
method_and_setup.setup: Three public benchmarks.

results.measures: reduction in time to first token
reduction in token usage

records.change_for_agents: Handle simple device-control intents locally and send the rest to the cloud.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Maps to iOS on-device routing.

records.title: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
records.claim: An LLM agent can keep text and image entity memory for real-time video generation with about 1% extra time.

method_and_setup.method: Memory agent on separate GPUs prefilling the generator's attention sink.
method_and_setup.setup: LongStory-Online benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots).

results.measures: persistent-state accuracy gain over LongLive-2.0

records.change_for_agents: Run memory updates asynchronously so the main loop never waits on them.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Async memory agent pattern.

records.title: P-FedSkill: A Personalized Federated Skill Learning Framework under Task Heterogeneity
records.claim: Personalized skill selection beats similarity-based skill sharing across clients with heterogeneous tasks.

method_and_setup.method: P-FedSkill: local skill extraction, personalized skill selection, task-aware skill routing.

records.change_for_agents: Share skills across clients by task-outcome contribution rather than similarity.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Skill sharing without sharing trajectories.
